text:
Situation: Mannitol has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-09-23, a span of 61 months as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory at Corvale East and Corvale General provides between 8.2 and 15.7 days on hand across four presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows mannitol listed continuously since 2021-09-23. Another registered plant for Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) was classified OAI on 2026-04-02, after the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) on 2026-09-29. B. Braun Medical Inc. is also a labeler for mannitol, but its plant inspection history is not provided in the evidence.

Our position: Supply is critically low. The rule-based best option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-10-13. Four additional suppliers not on FDA's shortage list are available as alternatives.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as primary source; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Hospira, Inc. (last inspection NAI 2025-02-07) as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate ICU Medical Inc., HF Acquisition Co LLC, and ProPharma Distribution for tertiary supply; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand projections; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending resolution of Baxter facility actions. Relying solely on current inventory without active replenishment.
